title: Kinako Pancakes with Zesty Syrup
description: A twist on traditional pancakes, these kinako pancakes are flavored with the nutty taste of kinako and served with a zesty syrup for a delicious breakfast treat.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together kinako and gluten-free pancake mix.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
If using, add 1 tsp of pillsbury and 1 tsp of cinnamon, and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and edges start to dry.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
To make zesty syrup, mix together 1/2 cup of powdered sugar, 1/4 cup of milk, and 1 tsp of vanilla extract in a small bowl.
Add 1 tsp of lemon juice and stir until combined.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat and simmer for 2-3 minutes, until thickened.
